use.zh-cn: 验证采样源反证保留、不成为目标类型／精度约束，未观察字段不变成确定 NULL，原始字段映射来源保持。
use.en: Verifies sampled counterexamples survive without becoming target type/precision constraints; unobserved fields never become known NULL and mapping provenance is preserved.
